note: Synthetic tracks only: a made-up MMSI sailing from square harbor geofences drawn in open ocean. Not a real vessel, port or fleet record. Each fix is [minute after t0_ms, lat, lon, sog_kn]; received_at = ts + receipt_delay_ms unless a fix carries a fifth element (its own receipt delay).

closed.purpose: A1/A4: harbor shuffle, departure, two sea legs, confirmed return to port A held past the debounce, then more harbor shuffle.

open.purpose: Healthy control/A2: the identical track ending at sea before any return.

open_zero_final.purpose: A2: open track whose final recorded leg is zero length (stationary fix).

closed_to_port_b.purpose: A1: departure from port A, confirmed return into port B; the return leg ends at the port B return fix.

closed_with_dip.purpose: A3: a one-minute dip into port A (shorter than the debounce) stays inside the trip; the later held stay is the return.

open_port_hint.purpose: A3: the data ends one minute after a first in-port fix, before the debounce: an in-port hint, not a confirmed return.

gap_truncated.purpose: A2: a silence longer than gap_split_hours, next seen in port: truncated at the last fix before the silence, no return leg.

start_unknown.purpose: A2/A4: positions begin at sea (unknown start) and end with a held return: truncated status, distance policy unchanged.

noise.purpose: A3: replayed duplicates of an existing ts with a later receipt and a displaced position; prepare() keeps the earliest receipt.
